author: zhenbinwu
body:
#### PR description:

- Making use of new dataformat of Phase2 DT, Phi-Theta matched pairs
- Extend the Kalman Muon Barrel Track Finding algorithm for more precise measurements of track eta and z
- Please test with data file from https://github.com/cms-data/L1Trigger-Phase2L1GMT/pull/2

#### PR validation:

Backport from https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/51111 and https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52187
Validated
title: [CMSSW_17_1_X] L1 GMT Upgrade of Kalman Filter for Barrel Muon KMTF
